description: Fist pressed firmly against center chest with distressed facial expression and pulsing hand movement.
suggestedReplies: Please sit down immediately. Medical team is coming.
Are you experiencing pain in your left arm or shortness of breath?
Take slow, deep breaths. A doctor is on the way.

translations.en: I have severe chest pain and need help.
translations.hi: मुझे सीने में तेज़ दर्द हो रहा है, तुरंत मदद चाहिए।
translations.te: నాకు గుండెలో తీవ్రమైన నొప్పిగా ఉంది, వెంటనే సహాయం కావాలి.

description: Both hands clutching neck or upper chest area with rapid upward motion indicating gasping for air.
suggestedReplies: Oxygen support is being prepared right now.
Try to keep your posture straight and take gentle breaths.
Do you have an inhaler with you?

translations.en: I cannot breathe properly.
translations.hi: मुझे सांस लेने में बहुत कठिनाई हो रही है।
translations.te: నాకు శ్వాస తీసుకోవడం చాలా కష్టంగా ఉంది.

concept: I need to see a doctor
description: Right hand index and middle finger tapping left inner wrist (pulse point check sign in ISL).
suggestedReplies: The duty doctor will examine you in room 4.
Please register at counter 1 and take a token.
Are you experiencing sudden pain or routine consultation?

translations.en: I need to consult a doctor.
translations.hi: मुझे डॉक्टर को दिखाना है।

description: Both hands touching temples with twisting fingertips indicating throbbing pain.
suggestedReplies: How long have you had this headache?
Are you feeling nauseous or sensitive to light?
Have you taken any pain relief medicine today?

translations.en: I have a severe headache.
translations.hi: मेरे सिर में बहुत तेज़ दर्द है।

description: Hands held over abdomen, rotating clockwise with arched posture.
suggestedReplies: Did the stomach ache start after eating?
Is the pain sharp or cramping?
Please lie on the examination bed.

translations.en: My stomach hurts.
translations.hi: मेरे पेट में दर्द हो रहा है।

concept: I am bleeding from an injury
description: Fingers fluttering downward from an arm or leg indicating flowing blood, followed by urgent point.
suggestedReplies: Press this sterile dressing firmly against the wound.
Emergency trauma nurse is applying a bandage immediately.
Keep the injured limb elevated if possible.

translations.en: I am bleeding and need first aid.
translations.hi: खून बह रहा है, तुरंत प्राथमिक उपचार चाहिए।
translations.te: రక్తం కారుతోంది, వెంటనే ప్రథమ చికిత్స కావాలి.

concept: How should I take this medicine?
description: Right hand mimicking putting a pill in mouth, followed by questioning open palms.
suggestedReplies: Take 1 tablet after meals, twice a day with water.
Do not take this on an empty stomach.
The pharmacist will write clear times on the prescription.

translations.en: When and how should I take this medication?
translations.hi: यह दवा कब और कैसे लेनी है?

concept: I have an allergy to medicine
description: Scratching forearm back and forth, then shaking head with crossed hands indicating negative reaction.
suggestedReplies: Which specific medicine or penicillin are you allergic to?
We will mark your chart with a red allergy band immediately.
Are you having any skin rashes or swelling?

translations.en: I have a known medical allergy.
translations.hi: मुझे इस दवा से एलर्जी है।

description: Both open palms facing downward, moving downward gently in a calm welcoming motion.
suggestedReplies: Thank you, I will sit.
Can I have a glass of water?
Where should I wait?

translations.en: Please sit down.
translations.hi: कृपया बैठ जाइए।

description: Raised open palm facing forward at shoulder level with gentle stillness.
suggestedReplies: Understood, I will wait here.
How many minutes will it take?
Thank you.

translations.en: Please wait for a moment.
translations.hi: कृपया एक पल प्रतीक्षा करें।

description: Index finger tapped to forehead, then sweeping outward with open upturned palms and questioning head tilt.
suggestedReplies: Which specific formula or step would you like me to re-explain?
Let's break this concept down with a simple visual example.
You can visit during office hours at 3:00 PM for one-on-one help.

translations.en: I do not understand this question or concept.
translations.hi: मुझे यह सवाल समझ में नहीं आया।

concept: Where is the classroom or lab?
description: Two hands forming a box/room outline, followed by open palms turning side to side (where sign).
suggestedReplies: Room 302 is on the 3rd floor, right next to the elevator.
The computer lab is in Block B on the ground floor.
Follow the corridor down to the main library entrance.

translations.en: Where is this classroom or laboratory located?
translations.hi: यह क्लासरूम या लैब कहाँ पर है?
translations.te: ఈ క్లాస్‌రూమ్ లేదా ల్యాబ్ ఎక్కడ ఉంది?

description: Left palm flat like a register, right index finger drawing a checkmark across it.
suggestedReplies: What is your roll number?
Your attendance has been recorded for this period.
Please submit your medical certificate for previous absence.

translations.en: Please check and mark my attendance.
translations.hi: कृपया मेरी उपस्थिति दर्ज करें।

description: Writing gesture on open left palm, followed by tapping index finger on wrist watch.
suggestedReplies: The mid-semester exam begins tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
Exam hall tickets are available on the student portal.
The exam duration is 2 hours with 20 minutes extra reading time.

translations.en: When is the examination scheduled?
translations.hi: परीक्षा का समय और तारीख क्या है?

concept: I need permission for sick leave
description: Flat hands pressed together in respect, then bowing slightly and presenting a leave letter motion.
suggestedReplies: Please fill out the leave slip and have the HOD sign it.
Take care of your health; leave is approved for 2 days.
Ensure you collect missed class lecture notes from a classmate.

translations.en: I am requesting leave permission due to health reasons.
translations.hi: मुझे बीमारी के कारण छुट्टी की अनुमति चाहिए।
translations.te: అనారోగ్యం కారణంగా నాకు సెలవు అనుమతి కావాలి.

concept: How do I borrow this book?
description: Both hands opening like a book, then gesturing a card swipe at the counter.
suggestedReplies: Scan your student ID card at the self-checkout kiosk.
You can borrow up to 3 books for 14 days.
Reference section books cannot be taken outside the library.

translations.en: How do I issue or return this library book?
translations.hi: यह लाइब्रेरी की किताब कैसे ले सकता हूँ?
translations.te: ఈ పుస్తకాన్ని లైబ్రరీ నుండి ఎలా తీసుకోవాలి?

description: Rectangular card outline drawn on chest pocket, then hands dropping open empty showing loss.
suggestedReplies: Do you have a copy of your Aadhaar card or phone number?
Fill out Form B-2 at counter 4 to apply for a duplicate ID.
Did you file a lost property report at the reception?

translations.en: I have lost my official identity card.
translations.hi: मेरा पहचान पत्र (आईडी कार्ड) खो गया है।

description: Right hand passing over left palm flipping imaginary page, then pointing forward asking for a new one.
suggestedReplies: Please provide your application reference number.
Replacement cards take 3 working days to process.
You will receive an SMS when it is ready for collection.

translations.en: I need a replacement or duplicate document.
translations.hi: मुझे नया प्रतिस्थापन दस्तावेज़ चाहिए।

concept: I need police or security assistance
description: Right hand touching forehead in salute, then pointing urgently with both hands.
suggestedReplies: Security officers are right outside this desk.
Are you in immediate physical danger?
Please come with me to the officer help desk.

translations.en: I need police or security officer assistance.
translations.hi: मुझे पुलिस या सुरक्षा सहायता की आवश्यकता है।
translations.te: నాకు పోలీసు లేదా భద్రతా సహాయం కావాలి.

description: Holding a sheet of paper gesture, then pointing along rows of counters with questioning expression.
suggestedReplies: Citizen certificate verification is at Counter 7.
Take a queue token from the touch kiosk near the entrance.
Counters 3 and 4 handle payment and fee collection.

translations.en: Which counter handles this specific service or form?
translations.hi: यह फॉर्म किस काउंटर पर जमा होगा?

concept: Where do I pay the application fee?
description: Thumb rubbing index and middle fingers (money sign) followed by pointing to cash counter.
suggestedReplies: You can pay via UPI, QR code, or cash at Counter 2.
The government processing fee is ₹50.
Please collect your official stamped receipt after payment.

translations.en: Where should I pay the service fee?
translations.hi: आवेदन शुल्क कहाँ जमा करना है?

description: Palms joined together at chest level in traditional Indian Namaste greeting with a gentle nod.
suggestedReplies: Hello! Welcome. How can I help you today?
Namaste! Please let me know what you need.
Good day! I am here to assist you.

translations.en: Hello / Namaste. Welcome.
translations.hi: नमस्ते! मैं आपकी क्या सहायता कर सकता हूँ?

description: Flat right hand fingertips touching chin/lips, then moving forward smoothly toward the other person.
suggestedReplies: You are very welcome! Take care.
Glad I could assist you.
Feel free to ask if you need anything else.

translations.en: Thank you very much.
translations.hi: आपका बहुत-बहुत धन्यवाद।

description: Closed right fist with thumb up, placed onto flat open left palm and lifted upward together.
suggestedReplies: I am here with you. What kind of help do you need?
Do you need a medical staff, security, or directions?
Please explain or point to what is wrong.

translations.en: I need help immediately.
translations.hi: मुझे तुरंत मदद चाहिए।

description: Closed right fist nodding up and down like a head nod.
suggestedReplies: Understood. We will proceed.
Great, thank you for confirming.
Let's move to the next step.

translations.en: Yes, that is correct.
translations.hi: हाँ, बिल्कुल सही।

description: Index, middle finger and thumb snapping closed horizontally with head shake.
suggestedReplies: Understood. Let me ask differently.
Okay, we will cancel that option.
Can you clarify what you mean?

translations.en: No, that is not correct.
translations.hi: नहीं, यह नहीं है।

description: Three middle fingers forming W-shape tapped against chin/lips twice.
suggestedReplies: Here is a bottle of fresh drinking water.
The water dispenser is right around the corner.
Let me get a clean glass for you.

translations.en: I need clean drinking water.
translations.hi: मुझे पीने का पानी चाहिए।
